hook: A mother and her baby, trapped by the flood.
narration: Floodwater swallowed this whole neighborhood in South Carolina, [short pause] and a mother was trapped in her house with her fifteen-month-old baby.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew flew in low over the rooftops.
When water is this high, a boat can't always get through. A helicopter can come straight down to one house.
Minutes later, mother and baby were up in the cabin.
outcome: The Coast Guard rescued the mother and her baby from the flooded house.
title: Trapped by floodwater with her baby
description:
Severe flooding inundated a neighborhood in Huger, South Carolina, on Oct. 4, 2015. A Coast Guard helicopter crew rescued a mother and her 15-month-old infant from their flooded house.

question_comment: Would you wait on the roof or try to get out through the water?
